Transcript history and retention limits apply only to data stored locally on this computer—nothing is sent to Vox Jot's servers because there is no cloud account.

automationAgents.title: Automation & Agents
automationAgents.description: Connect local scripts, shortcuts, and agent clients to Vox Jot without exposing the API beyond this Mac.
automationAgents.localApiDescription: Token-gated loopback access for local automation. The token is stored in the OS credential store and only revealed when you copy it.

notRanked.title: Blocked / unranked

targetLanguage.title: Target Language
targetLanguage.description: Choose the language Vox Jot should translate into.

method.title: Translation Method
method.description: Automatic works for most people. Choose a specific method only if you need one.

bilingualLayout.title: Bilingual Layout
